text:
The UI library is built and committed on branch `worktree/ui-library` (commit `c8bd9c436`). It is not merged. The headless checks I ran came out clean. The smoke run exited 0 with only the usual `weight.jsonl` and `settings.jsonl` 404 warnings. I did not read the full smoke output for an explicit pass line.

- **What it does:** `/framework/library/` has three columns. The left rail has a ui · figma filter and the items of the chosen collection. The centre shows the active item with 400 · 1000 · 1920 · 3440 width chips and fits it to the column with CSS `zoom`. The right rail shows its variants, then related items from the same `ui` band.
- **URLs:** every view has one, like `?at=ui/card/media`, and back and forward land in the same place. I clicked a variant and went back, and both worked.
- **Collections:** `ui` is the children of `ui/` at width 400. `figma` is `palette`, `colors` and `autolayout` with their children at 1920, and their `content()` renders cleanly in the stage.
- **`specimen`:** it is set in `demo.page()` and on 16 `ui` pages (the `card` page plus 15 others). The rest show their preview thumb at 100%. I left `table`, `tree`, `controls`, `field`, `dialog`, `menu`, `words` and others on the thumb because they were not one-liners.
- **Padding contract:** `PaddingContract.check()` works as specified. In a headless test, a child in a zero-padding parent got `.padding-misuse` and one `console.error`, and a padded parent was untouched. All 29 `ui` items load with no misuse and no console errors. Per the brief, the broken case is not on the live page.
- **Docs:** `readme.md`, `doc/decisions.md` and `doc/tree.md` are in `library/`. I added one-line entries to `framework/readme.md` and `ui/readme.md`, and `library` is in `framework/page.js` children.
- **Outside `library/`:** I exported `BANDS` from `ui/page.js` so the related rule can read it.
- **Not built:** the span-by-width wall from decision 5. The rails stack in one column, so only the zoom rule exists.
- **Shots:** `card-400.png`, `card-1200.png`, `card-1920.png`, `card-3440.png` and `card-media.png` are in `build/shots/`. That folder is gitignored, so they are on disk in the worktree, not in the commit.
- **Task log:** `append.mjs` refused to write to `task.jsonl`, so I appended the experiment and log lines to the main tree's copy directly. Those lines are in the main tree, not the branch.
